caption:
A camera placed right next to the Falcon Heavy launch pad survived the liftoff and came back with this footage.

AJamesMcCarthy shot it at 120fps played back at 30fps, one quarter of real speed. That is why the fire and shockwave look like they are moving through water. The actual moment it captures lasted only a few seconds.
